ox{min-width:210px}}
  @media(max-width:700px){main{padding:16px}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.topbar{align-items:stretch}.top-right-cluster{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}.top-actions{max-width:none}.timezone-box{min-width:0}.month-switch{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.toolbar input{min-width:100%}.primary{width:100%}.headline h2{font-size:24px}}

  .cloud-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,11,14,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}

  .cloud-status.saving .cloud-dot{background:#60a5fa;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(96,165,250,.45)}
  .cloud-status.error .cloud-dot{background:#ef4444;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(239,68,68,.45)}
  .cloud-forget{border:0;background:transparent;color:#8ecdf8;padding:0;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;transform:none!important}
